Operator environment needs Node 24 and PostgreSQL 17 clients. API images deliberately do not include native database clients.
Windows ACLs, encrypted scratch storage and independent key recovery ownership require operator acceptance; Unix file modes were verified in a non-root Linux container.
Generic restoration only accepts confirmed empty isolated loopback databases.
Initial empty-schema preparation, pg_restore SQL transaction, grants and verification are distinct phases; failures keep the target isolated.
